newsitem.title: TURKMENISTAN: Foreign investment in Turkmenistan totals $410 mln.
newsitem.headline: Foreign investment in Turkmenistan totals $410 mln.

text.p: Direct foreign investment by over 60 countries in the Turkmen economy has reached $410 million, a senior minister said on Thursday.

Foreign Economic Relations Minister Mered Orazov told a regional investment forum sponsored by Washington's USAID foreign assistance agency that the bulk of the investment had been made by Turkey, Argentina, the U.S. and Italy.

The foreign investment figure will be higher once 175 construction projects now in progress are completed and foreign involvement in them is included. The total cost of the projects is $3.4 billion, including $200.6 million to be invested by foreigners, Orazov said.
